dataset.description: In this data set, the results obtained on morphology, chemical composition, and electrochemical performance of nanostructured Bi<sub>2</sub>Se<sub>3</sub>-MWCNT networks in aqueous liquid zinc-ion electrolytes will be summarized and analyzed.

distribution.title: Within the WP1, nanostructured Bi2Se3-MWCNT cathode materials will be synthesized and their electrochemical performance will be tested at room- and low temperatures for the application in conventional and photo-rechargeable aqueous zinc-ion batteries. Morphology and chemical composition of the synthesized materials will be characterized using SEM-EDX, TEM, XRD, XPS methods. Electrochemical performance will be tested using cyclic voltammetry (CV), galvanostatic charge/discharge (GDC), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS).

dataset.title: WP1 - Bi2Se3-MWCNT cathodes for ZIBs employing liquid electrolyte

dataset.description: In this data set, the results obtained on morphology, chemical composition, and electrochemical performance of nanostructured Bi2Se3-MWCNT networks in quasi-solid-state zinc-ion electrolytes will be summarized and analyzed.

distribution.title: Within the WP2, the quasi-solid-state zinc-ion electrolytes will be developed and electrochemical performance of the electrolytes and of Bi<sub>2</sub>Se<sub>3</sub>-MWCNT nanostructured cathode materials will be tested at room- and low temperatures for the application in conventional and photo-rechargeable quasi-solid-state zinc-ion batteries.  Electrochemical performance will be tested using cyclic voltammetry (CV), galvanostatic charge/discharge (GDC), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS).

dataset.title: WP2 - Bi2Se3-MWCNT cathodes for ZIBs employing quasi-solid-state electrolyte

dataset.description: In this data set, the results of the electrochemical and energy storage performance of conventional and photo-rechargeable batteries assembled using the best-performing components developed during the project will be summarized and analyzed.

distribution.title: Within the WP3, the best-performing nanostructured Bi2Se3-MWCNT cathode materials and electrolytes will be used for assembling conventional and photo-rechargeable zinc-ion batteries. Electrochemical and energy-storage performance will be tested using cyclic voltammetry (CV), galvanostatic charge/discharge (GDC), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS).

dataset.title: WP3 - Construction and testing of prototypes of rechargeable conventional and photo-assisted ZIBs

dmp.description:
The Data Management Plan (DMP) is prepared in the framework of the Latvian Council of Science Fundamental and Applied Research project No. lzp-2024/1-0187 "Application of Bi2Se3-CNT heterostructures for conventional and photo-assisted low-temperature rechargeable Zn-ion batteries" (project leader: Prof., Dr. chem. Donats Erts, 01.01.2025. - 31.12.2027., 300 000.00 EUR).

The development of safe, reliable, environmentally friendly, and low-cost reversible energy storage plays an essential role in providing society with clean and green energy. Nowadays, Li-ion batteries (LIBs) dominate the market due to high energy density and lightness; however, LIBs have major drawbacks such as high cost, the toxicity of organic electrolytes, and high flammability. A promising alternative to LIBs is aqueous rechargeable Zn-ion batteries (ZIB). However, the performance of ZIBs is limited by cathode properties, which suffer from rapid capacity decay, low energy density, or modest specific capacity. In addition, all types of batteries experience poor performance or failure in cold climates. The main goal of this project is the development of advanced high-performance cathode binder-free materials capable of reversible Zn-ion accommodation not only at room temperature but also at low temperatures and able to serve as photo-cathodes, allowing simultaneous solar energy harvesting and storage in a single device.
